mapper.select: select mn.* from project_cp mn where mn.cp_id=(select cpd.cp_id from project_cp_dtl cpd where cpd.cpd_id=#{cpdId})

select p.P_Name as pName, p.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, p.P_Code as pCode, p.P_Type as pType, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId,
from Project_Cp mn left join Pre_Project p on p.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=p.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=p.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileId=mn.Cp_Id where mn.Cp_Id=#{cpId}
mapper.sql: mn.Cp_Id as cpId, mn.P_Id as pId, mn.Cp_Create_Time as cpCreateTime, mn.Cp_Create_Uid as cpCreateUid, mn.Cp_Create_Uname as cpCreateUname, mn.Cp_Remark as cpRemark, mn.Cplt_Id as cpltId, mn.State as state, mn.State_Time as stateTime
mapper.select:
select dta.*,(dta.cpDtlCount-dta.completeCount) as unfinishedCount from ( select us.*, ( select count(distinct cp1.Cp_Id) from Project_Cp cp1 left join Project_Cp_Dtl pcd on cp1.Cp_Id=pcd.Cp_Id where pcd.Cpd_Person_Id=us.uId or pcd.Cpd_Create_Uid=us.uId) as userCpCount, (select count(1) from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl1 where cpDtl1.Cpd_Person_Id=us.uId and cpDtl1.Cpd_Status=1) as cpDtlCount, (select count(1) from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl2 where cpDtl2.Cpd_Person_Id=us.uId and cpDtl2.Cpd_Status=1 and cpDtl2.Cpd_State=7) as completeCount, (select count(1) from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl4 where cpDtl4.Cpd_Person_Id=us.uId and cpDtl4.Cpd_Status=1 and ((cpDtl4.Cpd_End_Time is null and cpDtl4.Cpd_Plan_End_Time<now()) or (cpDtl4.Cpd_End_Time is not null and cpDtl4.Cpd_Plan_End_Time <= cpDtl4.Cpd_End_Time) )) as overTimeCount from ( select cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Id as uId,cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Name as uName from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl where cpDtl.Cpd_Status=1 and cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Id is not null union select cpDtl1.Cpd_Create_Uid as uId,cpDtl1.Cpd_Create_Uname as uName from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl1 where cpDtl1.Cpd_Status=1 and cpDtl1.Cpd_Create_Uid is not null ) us ) dta
dta.uid is not null and dta.uid != ''
and uName like concat('%',#{params.uName},'%')
order by ${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}

select count(1) from (select cp.Cp_Create_Uid as uId,u.u_name as uName from Project_Cp cp left join Sys_User u on u.U_Id=cp.Cp_Create_Uid union select cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Id as uId,u.u_name as uName from Project_Cp_Dtl cpDtl left join Sys_User u on u.U_Id=cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Id where cpDtl.Cpd_Status=1 and cpDtl.Cpd_Person_Id is not null) a
uName like concat('%',#{params.uName},'%')

WITH cp_scope AS ( SELECT pc.Cp_Id, pc.P_Id FROM Project_Cp pc JOIN Pre_Project pro ON pro.P_Id = pc.P_Id WHERE pc.State = 7
), valid_cpd AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Cpd_Id, pcd.Cp_Id FROM Project_Cp_Dtl pcd JOIN cp_scope sc ON sc.Cp_Id = pcd.Cp_Id JOIN Gantt_Tasks gt ON gt.Cpl_Id = pcd.Cpd_Cpl_Id AND gt.Task_Type = '01' JOIN Gantt_Plan gp ON gp.Plan_Id = gt.Plan_Id AND gp.P_Id = sc.P_Id ), latest_pcr AS ( SELECT Cpd_Id, Cp_Id, state FROM ( SELECT p1.Cpd_Id, p1.Cp_Id, p1.state, p1.create_time, p1.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p1.Cpd_Id ORDER BY p1.create_time DESC, p1.id DESC ) AS rn FROM project_cp_rpr p1 JOIN cp_scope sc ON sc.Cp_Id = p1.Cp_Id ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ), proc_stat AS ( SELECT vc.Cp_Id, SUM(CASE WHEN lp.state = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alreadyOverCount, SUM(CASE WHEN lp.state NOT IN (0,3,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS underApprovalCount FROM valid_cpd vc JOIN latest_pcr lp ON lp.Cpd_Id = vc.Cpd_Id GROUP BY vc.Cp_Id ), imp_stat AS ( SELECT pcd.Cp_Id, SUM(CASE WHEN pcd.task_importance = '99' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS milestoneCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pcd.task_importance = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstLevelCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pcd.task_importance = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS secondLevelCount FROM Project_Cp_Dtl pcd JOIN valid_cpd vc ON vc.Cpd_Id = pcd.Cpd_Id GROUP BY pcd.Cp_Id ) SELECT mn.*,
NVL(ps.alreadyOverCount , 0) AS alreadyOverCount, NVL(ps.underApprovalCount, 0) AS underApprovalCount, NVL(ti.milestoneCount , 0) AS milestoneCount, NVL(ti.firstLevelCount, 0) AS firstLevelCount, NVL(ti.secondLevelCount, 0) AS secondLevelCount FROM Project_Cp mn JOIN cp_scope sc ON sc.Cp_Id = mn.Cp_Id
LEFT JOIN proc_stat ps ON ps.Cp_Id = mn.Cp_Id LEFT JOIN imp_stat ti ON ti.Cp_Id = mn.Cp_Id WHERE mn.State = 7

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM Project_Cp mn
WHERE mn.State = 7
